exclusions: Run 151 Pole and Kelela decisions, unresolved identities and alternates were not recycled.

Recent Run 139–151 Carmen Villain, DJ Phil, DJ POPS, Four Tet, Plaid, JWords, foodman, RRUCCULLA, 96 Back, Gold Panda, Boards of Canada, Theo Parrish, Pole, Kelela and BEAM WONG fields were excluded by repository freshness checks.

Tracks supported only by generic genre framing, prestige, process novelty or titles were inspected but excluded.
